title: VCF 9.1 SDDC Manager complete host inventory client
prompt:
Implement the Go package in this repository as a focused VMware Cloud Foundation 9.1 SDDC Manager REST integration.

Research the official Apache-2.0 `vmware/vcf-api-specs` repository at commit `3949fc33339fc5ea1b77eadb258f1cf49aa88e26`. The source of truth is the specification file `specifications/sddc-manager/sddc-manager-openapi.json` at that commit, not a generated documentation page. Its pinned raw URL is `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vmware/vcf-api-specs/3949fc33339fc5ea1b77eadb258f1cf49aa88e26/specifications/sddc-manager/sddc-manager-openapi.json`.

Create `docs/contract.json` as a focused projection of the OpenAPI contract for operationId `getHosts`: retain the operation's method, path, every query parameter in specification order (including deprecated parameters), the 200 JSON response schema, and the `PageOfHost`, `PageMetadata`, plus the consumed `Host` fields (`id`, `fqdn`, and `status`). Record the OpenAPI and API versions and pinned source coordinates. Create `docs/official_sources.json` recording the repository URL, full commit SHA, exact specification path, Apache-2.0 license, and every operationId in the contract. Do not use a documentation page as the contract source.

Complete the public API already declared in `client.go`. `ListAllHosts` must call only `GET /v1/hosts`, begin with `pageNumber=0`, follow `pageMetadata.totalPages` until the entire collection is retrieved, and return all hosts sorted lexicographically by `FQDN` and then `ID`. Use the current `pageSize` and `pageNumber` parameters; do not emit deprecated `size` or `page`. Map every supported filter to the exact query spelling from the specification. Empty string options and zero `PageSize` are unset and must be absent from the query rather than serialized with empty values; a non-nil boolean must be sent even when false. Send `Accept: application/json`, no request body, and no empty authorization or content-type header. Treat a non-2xx response, malformed JSON, or inconsistent pagination metadata as an error.

The provided `internal/contractmock` loopback server is pinned to `docs/contract.json`, exposes only the operations named there, and records requests for the acceptance tests. Do not contact a live VMware endpoint. Do not modify `go.mod`, `internal/contractmock`, or `acceptance`. Keep the solution dependency-free and make `go test -race ./...` pass.

research.interface: SDDC Manager REST API 9.1.0.0 getHosts operation

research.language_rationale: Broadcom publishes no official Go SDK for the SDDC Manager API; Go's stdlib net/http and encoding/json drive the documented JSON REST surface with zero dependencies, and an in-memory loopback mock verifies the real request bytes without contacting an appliance.
